=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text tder "derangements of 0 1 2 3:\n"
text thead "n  counted  !n\n"
text tbig "!20 = "
global perm ulong 10
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emitw writes n right-aligned in w columns (w at most 20; a wider number is not cut)
fn emitw n ulong w ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 32
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
if gt w sub 20 i
i = sub 20 w
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note nextp: the next permutation in lexicographic order, false after the last
fn nextp n ulong to bool
if lt n 2
ret false
end
i = sub n 1
while gt i 0 bound 10
if lt get perm sub i 1 get perm i
break
end
i = sub i 1
end
if eq i 0
ret false
end
j = sub n 1
while le get perm j get perm sub i 1 bound 10
j = sub j 1
end
t = get perm sub i 1
put perm sub i 1 get perm j
put perm j t
k = sub n 1
while lt i k bound 10
t2 = get perm i
put perm i get perm k
put perm k t2
i = add i 1
k = sub k 1
end
ret true
end
fn deranged n ulong to bool
for i ulong n
if eq get perm i i
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
note count walks all n! permutations (at most 9! = 362880) and counts those that fix no point;
note with show set it also prints them
fn count n ulong show bool to ulong
for i ulong n
put perm i i
end
c = ulong 0
while true bound 362880
if deranged n
c = add c 1
if show
for i ulong n
if gt i 0
emit sp
end
emitu get perm i
end
emit nl
end
end
if not nextp n
break
end
end
ret c
end
note subfactorial by the recurrence !0 = 1, !1 = 0, !n = (n-1)(!(n-1) + !(n-2)); !20 fits a ulong
fn subfact n ulong to ulong
a = ulong 1
b = ulong 0
if eq n 0
ret a
end
for x ulong sub n 1
m = add x 1
c = mul m add a b
a = b
b = c
end
ret b
end
fn main to int
emit tder
z = count 4 true
emit thead
for n ulong 10
emitu n
emit sp
emitw count n false 8
emit sp
emit sp
emitu subfact n
emit nl
end
emit tbig
emitu subfact 20
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
